text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm Buena Vista. Pleased to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That sparkle seen that day... that dream scenery—
The challenge toward that breathtaking view finally begins.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I've been waiting for this moment forever.
Let's fulfill our promise from "that day" together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
